concepts.name: D — Maison du Zodiaque
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create one high-fidelity Home Assistant dashboard concept screenshot, landscape 1536x1024. Original design closely inspired by Alphonse Mucha's 1890s color lithograph posters and decorative panels. The style must be unmistakably Mucha: strong flat brown contour lines, broad pale color fields, muted ochre/cream/sage/dusty rose, elegantly drawn allegorical women in modest flowing gowns, luxuriant flowing ribbon-like hair, patterned circular halos, finely subdivided mosaic ornament, integrated hand-lettered poster typography, nature and figure composed into architectural panels. Matte printed lithograph quality, restrained subtle paper texture. Flat screen view, no device, no browser chrome. Avoid generic fantasy interface, neon, metallic 3D gold bevels, glowing controls, photorealistic faces, generic stock floral corner decorations, stained-glass material, Art Deco fans and steps. Must remain a usable dashboard with legible labels, real buttons and sliders, empty breathing room around controls. Illustration is integral to composition, not a full picture underneath illegible widgets.
Content uses user's actual dashboard sections: top navigation Home, Floor Plan, Media, Yard, Alexandria. Scenes: Living room on, Good night, All lamps off, Pause music. Now Playing: simple original album art, track information, play/pause/skip and volume. Climate: 68°F sample reading, obvious controls. Rooms: Living Room with Couch, Chez Lounge, Pappasan, Window lamp; Library with Torch front, Torch back, Fireplace; Outside with Outdoor 1, Outdoor 2, Sunset schedule; Workshop with Icarus 3D printer and progress. Sample states only. Include a theme SELECTOR, not toggle, with current concept name and downward caret. Existing themes Deco Noir and Deco Noir Lite must be retained as options if menu is shown. Clearly identifiable sample UI controls.
COMPOSITION D: "Maison du Zodiaque". Closely study the compositional language of Mucha's Zodiac (1896) and La Plume calendar: a regal woman in profile with abundant red-brown flowing hair, jeweled headdress and a huge circular mosaic halo becomes a prominent tall LEFT PANEL occupying about 24% of the screen. Original portrait, no copy of a specific image. Her hair's sweeping shapes form the lower panel border and flow toward the dashboard. Small crescent and floral medallions embedded in the halo; modest pale embroidered robe. The Home title is integrated into its lower cartouche. This is the primary visual anchor. Remaining 76% is a disciplined useful dashboard, three compact upper panels Scenes / Now Playing / Climate, with four narrower room panels below. Top navigation across full width. Warm ivory ground, desaturated sage, terracotta and soft honey color with aubergine-brown outlines. Patterned rectangular frames with arch-shaped caps and dot/mosaic insets; flat graphic treatment rather than wispy gold filigree. Express Mucha through the entire layout, including heading letterforms and alternating bands of ornament. Small theme dropdown reads "Maison du Zodiaque". Bottom caption "D · Maison du Zodiaque". Full dashboard fits without cropped controls.

concepts.name: E — Les Saisons
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create one high-fidelity Home Assistant dashboard concept screenshot, landscape 1536x1024. COMPOSITION E: "Les Saisons". Closely inspired by Mucha's The Seasons (1896) and The Flowers (1898), four decorative vertical panels become the room layout itself. No giant Zodiac portrait sidebar: this is a distinctly different composition. Across the upper 35% of the screen, navigation, a gracefully lettered Home title, and compact Scenes, Now Playing and Climate controls on calm ivory panels. Lower 60% consists of FOUR tall equal room panels with round arch tops. At top of each room panel, an original slender allegorical woman amid plants is integrated as a miniature lithographic vignette, taking upper third of each panel, with useful toggles and readings underneath on light clear grounds. Living Room = Spring with blossom and pale rose; Library = Summer with cream flowers and sage; Outside = Autumn with muted russet leaves; Workshop = Winter with blue-grey branches and pale drapery. The women are modestly clothed in flowing gowns, flowing hair, natural poses inspired by Mucha's decorative panels, elegant faces and flattened color. Fine printed brown contour lines and pale pastel fields. No card drop shadows, no modern glossy gradients. Strong rhythm of four columns, decorative lettered headers, flower stems naturally define the panel edges and transform into flat ornamental dividers. Theme dropdown at upper right is OPEN showing "Deco Noir", "Deco Noir Lite", "Les Saisons" selected. Footer caption "E · Les Saisons". Make it feel like a functional dashboard designed as an authentic Mucha decorative panel ensemble.
